A '''turbo-dart''' was a device that was used for recreational activity during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] had a turbo-dart set at their designated area of the [[GAR clone barracks]].
